results.description:
In Mountain Shadow, things are seldom what they seem. The veil between realms is frayed and thin. Demons lurk in the shadows. And sometimes enemies become necessary allies.

The Grimes sisters aren't normal — even by witches' standards. For weeks, Fiona has been having chilling visions of death, and Eleanor sees restless spirits nearly everywhere she goes.

When a string of unusual murders rocks their small mountain town, Fiona and the rest of her coven begin to worry that the killer may be one of their own. Even worse? A witch hunter has just moved in next door, and he knows Fiona's secret.

When it seems that her sister might be the next victim, Fiona must join forces with a man she hates to stop the killer before it's too late.

Aether Witch is Charmed meets Gilmore Girls. If you love a witchy paranormal fantasy with magic, witty banter, and unforgettable small-town characters, this book is for you. Grab your copy today!
